passages.note: Aye on the Assembly concurrence vote, which was on the chaptered SAFETY Act text; 16 of 77 voting No, so not near-unanimous.

passages.provision_quote: shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose any information related to a pupil’s sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression to any other person without the pupil’s consent, unless otherwise required by state or federal law.
passages.note: Operative Section 220.5 forbids school rules requiring disclosure; Section 220.3 only removes a duty to disclose and does not require staff to withhold, so it does not reach rung 1.

rows.reasoning: Carrillo voted Aye on final Assembly passage (concurrence) of AB 1955, whose operative Section 220.5 says schools "shall not enact or enforce any policy, rule, or administrative regulation that would require an employee or a contractor to disclose" a pupil's gender identity without consent, matching the rung "Forbid rules that require schools to tell parents." The bill requires no withholding by staff (excluding "Require staff to keep a student's gender identity from parents unless the student consents") and requires no notice or permission (excluding the notification rungs).
